title: Enterprise PyTorch/GPU to TPU/JAX Workload Migration: 3-Lane Triage, XLA De-Trapping & 14-Day PoC Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Blind 1:1 Line-by-Line PyTorch/XLA Port of All 40 Workloads (No AST Audit)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: Wastes months rewriting custom CUDA ops & hits 16.4% MFU from .item() syncs

tiers.name: Tier 2: Zero Migration (Keep 100% of Standard LLMs on On-Demand/Clos GPU Pools)
tiers.verdict: Zero migration effort, but forfeits 41%+ TPU7x/v6e price-performance & OCS scaling gains

tiers.name: Tier 3: Custom From-Scratch JAX Rewrite for Every Model (Ignoring Turnkey MaxText/vLLM-TPU)
tiers.verdict: Good runtime speed, but 6.8 weeks/model of redundant JAX boilerplate & numerics bugs

tiers.name: Tier 4: 3-Lane Triage (65% Turnkey MaxText/vLLM-TPU + 20% TorchAX/SPMD + 15% GPU) + 14-Day PoC
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 98.5% PoC pass rate, 57.8% MFU, 1.2-wk migration & -54.9% TCO ($1.42M/mo)
